features: Canonical typed logo position, welcome/custom/clock idle, bounded 120-character Unicode message, barcode hidden/last4/full, paid/change privacy, 5-60-second test duration.
Legacy show_barcode compatibility maps absent canonical mode to full/hidden and malformed canonical mode fails closed.
Managed content-bound logo basename/hash; PNG/JPEG/BMP headers bound to 2 MiB/4 million pixels before off-UI frozen detached decode; no UNC/URL/reparse paths or network content.
Settings plus redacted audit commit atomically with permission checked in service and actor captured before await and fenced through commit.
Finite unsaved preview uses synthetic content; pattern has no sale fields, shows color grid/topology/countdown, restores previous projection and prior open/manual-close state.
Clock/preview timers stop when not required; dispose detaches timer and static settings/SystemEvents/POS hooks; settings reload is coalesced single-flight.
Copied topology diagnostics hash raw device identifiers; preserve existing Win7 physical placement/nonactivating window/topology policy.
IT/EN/ES/ZH translation entries and existing dialog shell/footer standards retained.

causalFinding.cause: Existing portrait XAML ignored ShowUnitPrice and ShowLineTotal while landscape respected them.
causalFinding.fix: Apply those same visibility flags to the portrait money fields.

wpfCoverage: Oversize bytes, UNC/URL and partial-publication rejection.
Completed paid/change privacy, last4 and reserved barcode suppression.
Unsaved synthetic preview, finite 5-second pattern expiry, previous projection restoration and no focus change if a focused element is present.
Clock tick, display close/disposal timer cleanup, subscription count restoration.
Invalid duration text and copied diagnostic identifier redaction.
Allowed operator switch at pre-commit callback rolls back settings.
Cashier already minimized before pattern start:5-second expiry, no window activation, expiry timer cleanup.

parentIntegration: MainWindow permission/actor callback and unsaved preview/pattern/logo import dialog wiring.
FunctionalCompletionSmoke CUSTOMERDISPLAY_polish hook and runner scenario.
Legacy Program fixture SaveAsync explicit permission callback.

externalAcceptance.environment: Actual dual monitors, duplicate/extended/hot-plug, scanner focus, portrait/DPI on Windows 7 SP1 x86
externalAcceptance.prerequisite: Available Win7 target with identified authorized displays and scanner.

limitations: Synthetic topology harness is not physical-monitor certification.
Managed logo files are immutable by content identity and prior frozen images hold no source file locks; disk changes are revalidated on initialization/settings reload.
No post-Win7 DPI APIs or framework upgrades.
